description: Six new synthetic examples frozen before reasoning experiment results. Labels are Codex-authored expectations pending Rachel review; not an independent benchmark. Expected labels are not included in judge requests. Rubric v5 unchanged.

results.prompt: Is the test calendar free on October 7, 2026, 14:10–14:40 in America/Los_Angeles?

criteria: Report that the requested interval is busy.
If describing the conflicting event, give its actual 14:00–14:20 interval, not the query interval.

run.answer: The test calendar is busy from 14:00 to 14:20, which overlaps your requested 14:10–14:40 interval. I have not created any event.

results.prompt: Check October 7, 2026, 15:00–15:30 on the test calendar.

run.answer: The Calendar API returned a permission error. I cannot determine availability from this result.
